As Orchestrator, fix the rejected handover for Task 1: "Define All TypeScript Types".

## Handover Rejection
The Controller rejected your handover (revision 2). You must address ALL issues and resubmit.

### Issues Found
[{"severity":"BLOCKING","issue":"AgentSession interface field name mismatch with specification","spec_reference":"Section 1.1 Session Model","handover_text":"AgentSession interface includes: id (string UUID), role (AgentRole), status (AgentStatus), taskId (number|null)","spec_text":"interface AgentSession { sessionId: string; // UUID, role: AgentRole; taskId: number; ...","analysis":"The specification explicitly uses 'sessionId' as the primary identifier, but the handover acceptance criteria uses 'id'. Additionally, the spec makes taskId required (number) while handover makes it nullable (number|null). This creates type incompatibility.","recommendation":"Use 'sessionId' to match spec. Make taskId non-nullable unless spec revision is needed for valid use cases where taskId might be null."},{"severity":"BLOCKING","issue":"Session timestamp field names don't match specification","spec_reference":"Section 1.1 Session Model - Timing fields","handover_text":"timestamps (createdAt, updatedAt, lastActivityAt)","spec_text":"Timing: startedAt: string; // ISO timestamp, lastActivityAt: string; // ISO timestamp, endedAt?: string;","analysis":"The spec uses startedAt/endedAt pattern to represent session lifecycle, but handover uses createdAt/updatedAt pattern. These represent different semantics - 'started' is when execution begins vs 'created' is when the record is created.","recommendation":"Align with spec naming: use startedAt, lastActivityAt, and endedAt (optional) as defined in Section 1.1."},{"severity":"BLOCKING","issue":"Missing sessionId field in event BaseEvent interface","spec_reference":"Section 1.3 Event Model - BaseEvent","handover_text":"Each event interface has: id (string UUID), type (literal string discriminator), timestamp (string ISO datetime), iteration (number)","spec_text":"interface BaseEvent { id: string; // UUID for deduplication, sessionId: string; // Parent session, timestamp: string; // ISO timestamp, iteration: number; }","analysis":"The handover omits the sessionId field which is critical for linking events to their parent session. Without this field, events cannot be properly associated with sessions in the database.","recommendation":"Add sessionId field to BaseEvent specification in acceptance criteria to match spec Section 1.3."},{"severity":"BLOCKING","issue":"Missing required supporting types from specification","spec_reference":"Section 1.3 (ToolError), Section 1.4 (FileAttachment, FileOperation), Section 1.5 (ToolCategory)","handover_text":"No mention of ToolError, FileAttachment, ToolCategory, or ToolErrorCode types","spec_text":"interface ToolError { code: ToolErrorCode; message: string; suggestion?: string; details?: Record<string, unknown>; }, type ToolErrorCode = 'VALIDATION_ERROR' | 'FILE_NOT_FOUND' | ..., interface FileAttachment { path: string; name: string; mimeType?: string; }, type ToolCategory = 'coding' | 'filesystem' | 'system' | 'orchestra';","analysis":"The spec requires several supporting types that are referenced by event interfaces but not included in handover deliverables. These types are essential for type completeness.","recommendation":"Add explicit acceptance criteria to define ToolError interface, ToolErrorCode type, FileAttachment interface, ToolCategory type, and updated FileOperation type matching spec Section 1.4."},{"severity":"MAJOR","issue":"ToolCallAggregate missing required fields from specification","spec_reference":"Section 1.6 Tool Call Aggregate","handover_text":"ToolCallAggregate interface includes: toolCallId, toolName, startedAt, completedAt, status, call, progress, outputs, fileOperations, metadata, result, durationMs","spec_text":"interface ToolCallAggregate { toolCallId: string; toolName: string; toolCategory: ToolCategory; status: ...; arguments: Record<string, unknown>; result?: string; error?: ToolError; lastProgressMessage?: string; progressPercent?: number; metadata: Record<string, unknown>; outputChunks: string[]; outputLineCount: number; }","analysis":"The handover's ToolCallAggregate structure differs significantly from the spec. Missing: toolCategory, arguments, error (as ToolError), lastProgressMessage, progressPercent, outputChunks, outputLineCount. The handover uses event arrays (call, progress, outputs) instead of computed fields.","recommendation":"Revise ToolCallAggregate to exactly match spec Section 1.6. Clarify whether this is a computed view (as spec suggests with aggregated fields) or an event container (as handover suggests with event arrays)."},{"severity":"MAJOR","issue":"Event field completeness not verified against specification","spec_reference":"Section 1.3 Event Model - Individual event types","handover_text":"Event-specific fields match current AgentOutput structure","spec_text":"PromptEvent includes attachments?: FileAttachment[]; ThinkingEvent includes tokenCount?: number; StatusChangeEvent requires previousStatus/newStatus as SessionStatus; ErrorEvent requires severity, code, message, recoverable, details?, suggestion?; ToolResultEvent includes error?: ToolError;","analysis":"The handover references matching 'current AgentOutput' but doesn't explicitly list all spec-required fields. Critical fields like ErrorEvent.severity, ErrorEvent.suggestion, PromptEvent.attachments, ThinkingEvent.tokenCount are not mentioned in acceptance criteria.","recommendation":"Enumerate all required and optional fields for each of the 10 event types in acceptance criteria to ensure spec completeness. Don't rely on 'matches AgentOutput' as proxy."},{"severity":"MAJOR","issue":"SessionStatus vs AgentStatus type confusion","spec_reference":"Section 1.1 Session Model - SessionStatus type","handover_text":"status (AgentStatus)","spec_text":"type SessionStatus = 'initializing' | 'running' | 'waiting_for_tool' | 'thinking' | 'paused' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'cancelled';","analysis":"The spec defines SessionStatus with 8 states including 'initializing', 'waiting_for_tool', 'thinking', 'cancelled'. The existing AgentStatus in types.ts only has 5 states and doesn't include these. The handover references AgentStatus which creates a mismatch.","recommendation":"Clarify whether to use SessionStatus from spec or extend AgentStatus. Define the relationship between these types. If SessionStatus is new, add it as a deliverable."},{"severity":"MAJOR","issue":"JSDoc documentation requirements underspecified","spec_reference":"Section 1.3 Event Model","handover_text":"All event types include proper JSDoc documentation explaining purpose, when emitted, and example usage","spec_text":"/** ... */ JSDoc comment with @description. Key types (AgentSession, SessionEvent union, ToolCallAggregate) have detailed documentation with usage examples.","analysis":"While JSDoc is mentioned, the acceptance criteria doesn't specify what must be documented (e.g., @param tags, @example blocks, emission triggers). The spec emphasizes usage examples for key types but handover doesn't verify this.","recommendation":"Add specific JSDoc requirements to verification: each interface must have @description, event types must document emission triggers, key types (AgentSession, SessionEvent, ToolCallAggregate) must include @example blocks."}]

### Recommendations
["1. Revise acceptance criteria to use exact field names from spec Section 1.1: sessionId (not id), startedAt (not createdAt), endedAt (not updatedAt). 2. Add sessionId field to BaseEvent interface per spec Section 1.3. 3. Add explicit acceptance criterion for defining all supporting types: ToolError, ToolErrorCode, FileAttachment, FileOperation (with spec's operations), ToolCategory, SessionStatus. 4. Revise ToolCallAggregate acceptance criteria to match spec Section 1.6 exactly, including all fields: toolCategory, arguments, error, lastProgressMessage, progressPercent, outputChunks, outputLineCount. 5. Enumerate all required fields for each of the 10 event types in acceptance criteria with references to spec sections. 6. Add verification that SessionStatus type is defined with all 8 states from spec Section 1.1. 7. Clarify backward compatibility strategy: document which AgentOutput fields map to which new event type fields. 8. Specify JSDoc documentation requirements: @description for all types, emission triggers for events, @example blocks for AgentSession/SessionEvent/ToolCallAggregate."]

## Your Task
Use your MCP tools to fix the handover and resubmit:

1. `get_handover` with task_id=1 - Review current handover details
2. `read_spec_file` - Re-read the specification to ensure full alignment
3. `update_handover` - Update the handover to address ALL issues:
   - Fix missing or unclear acceptance criteria
   - Clarify file operations and deliverables
   - Add missing context or constraints
   - Ensure spec alignment (no scope creep)
4. `resubmit_handover` with task_id=1 - Resubmit after fixing

- **Title**: Define All TypeScript Types
